metadata.body:
Adds Java agent conformance coverage for Apache HBase 1.7.2 and 2.4.18 clients. The scenarios exercise Get, Put, Scan, and batch operations against the stable database semantic conventions.

The database runner builds checksum-verified local HBase fixtures for both client API lines, seeds the test table, and classifies HBase spans as `db.hbase.client`.

HBase fixtures bind fixed loopback ports 2181, 16000, and 16020, so only one HBase conformance package can run on a host at a time.
metadata.title: Add Java HBase database conformance
